title: Unique page-two spectral-sequence map induced by a spectral-object morphism
statement: Let C be an abelian category and let X and Y be EInt-indexed abelian spectral objects. Every morphism φ : X ⟶ Y induces a unique morphism e : X.E₂SpectralSequence ⟶ Y.E₂SpectralSequence such that for every p,q the page-two component of e, followed by the canonical first-page comparison for Y, equals the canonical first-page comparison for X followed by the component of φ on H^(p+q)(q,q+1).

source.place: Tags 012K and 015K; finite kernel/image page maps and induction through successor-page homology isomorphisms

proof.text: Apply the stated existence theorem for the kernel/image construction to obtain a spectral-sequence morphism satisfying the page-two comparison equation.

For uniqueness, cancel the comparison isomorphism to show that two candidate maps agree on page two. Induct on r ≥ 2 using the successor-page isomorphisms and the commutation equations of spectral-sequence morphisms.
Apply SpectralSequence.hom_ext to conclude equality of the morphisms from equality on every page.

proof_origin.place: Existence is split to the kernel/image construction theorem; uniqueness is proved by page induction in Lean.

lean.statement: theorem exists_unique_pageTwoMap {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C] [Abelian C] {X Y : SpectralObject C EInt} (φ : X ⟶ Y) : ∃ e : X.E₂SpectralSequence ⟶ Y.E₂SpectralSequence, (∀ (p q : ℤ), (e.hom 2).f (p, q) ≫ (pageTwoComparison Y (Iso.refl _) p q (p + q) rfl).hom = (pageTwoComparison X (Iso.refl _) p q (p + q) rfl).hom ≫ (φ.hom (p + q)).app (ComposableArrows.mk₁ (homOfLE (by simp : (q : EInt) ≤ ((q + 1 : ℤ) : EInt))))) ∧ ∀ e' : X.E₂SpectralSequence ⟶ Y.E₂SpectralSequence, (∀ (p q : ℤ), (e'.hom 2).f (p, q) ≫ (pageTwoComparison Y (Iso.refl _) p q (p + q) rfl).hom = (pageTwoComparison X (Iso.refl _) p q (p + q) rfl).hom ≫ (φ.hom (p + q)).app (ComposableArrows.mk₁ (homOfLE (by simp : (q : EInt) ≤ ((q + 1 : ℤ) : EInt))))) → e' = e
